sources.entry: Secluso - Private DIY home security camera system for Raspberry Pi, with end-to-end encrypted remote access and mobile apps for live video, alerts, and recording playback. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Rust

summary.one_liner: Secluso is a self-hostable, end-to-end encrypted DIY home security camera system built for Raspberry Pi, with mobile apps for live video, alerts, and encrypted recording playback.
summary.what_it_does: Secluso runs a home camera on a Raspberry Pi and lets you watch live video, receive alerts, and open recordings from a phone without sending footage to a cloud provider. Remote access goes through a relay that the README describes as untrusted, with end-to-end encryption between the camera and the phone. Secluso Deploy is a desktop tool that generates a personalized Secluso OS image and camera secret QR code locally, then provisions the relay over SSH or helps you get free beta relay hosting by email. Pairing is done through the mobile app after the Pi boots. The README also says the security model (forward secrecy and post-compromise security) is documented in WHITE_PAPER.md. The project publishes a prebuilt Secluso OS image and says its runtime binaries, deploy tool, Android app and OS are reproducible from public source.
use_cases: DIY home security camera on a Raspberry Pi
remote live video from home without a cloud service
encrypted camera recording playback on a phone
self-hosted alerts for home motion or activity
deploying a private camera relay on a Linux VPS
how_to_run: Download Secluso Deploy from the latest releases.
Generate your personalized Secluso OS image and camera secret QR code locally.
Let Secluso Deploy provision your relay over SSH, or email the maintainers for free beta relay hosting.
Boot the Raspberry Pi and pair it in the mobile app.
notable: Untrusted-relay design with end-to-end encryption, forward secrecy and post-compromise security (per WHITE_PAPER.md)
Secluso Deploy generates credentials locally and injects them into a prebuilt Secluso OS image
Reproducible builds for runtime binaries, deploy tool, Android app and Secluso OS
Supports Raspberry Pi Camera Module V1/V2 and other OV5647 or IMX219 sensor cameras
caveats: Requires a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W, a supported camera, and either your own Linux VPS or the beta relay offered by email
README says the project provides no guarantees of privacy or home security and is used at your own risk
Cryptography use may be subject to local laws, per the README disclaimer
